answer: No agent joins the trusted set for free: each identity posts a refundable stake bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest its honest work over many epochs. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly. Reputation bends but never snaps, like a willow, grown ring by ring in a slow spiral of attestations; a lone plume of self-praise buys nothing without a verified history.
